variants.label: Equipment Schedule
variants.tooltip: A component that provides a visualization that conveys equipment scheduling information in a concise and easily digestible format.

addEnabled.description: Enables or disables the UI interaction and event handling of adding events.

resizeEnabled.description: Enables or disables the UI interaction and event handling of resizing events.

moveEnabled.description: Enables or disables the UI interaction and event handling of moving events.

deleteEnabled.description: Enables or disables the UI interaction and event handling of deleting events.

clickEnabled.description: Enables or disables the UI interaction and event handling of clicking events.

id.description: Item identifier that is used to map scheduled events and downtime. If no id is specified, then no row is created in the schedule.

label.description: The label to be used as the title of the row. Uses the ID if empty.

iconConfig.description: Icon to be displayed in the item next to the label.

headerBackgroundColor.description: The background color of the label used for the item.

headerFontColor.description: The font color of the label used for the item.

headerFontSize.description: The font size of the label used for the item.

headerStyle.description: Style applied to the label header.

rowBackgroundColor.description: The background color for the item.

rowBottomBorderColor.description: The border bottom color for the item.

rowBottomBorderWidth.description: The border bottom width for the item.

rowBottomBorderStyle.description: The border bottom style for the item.

dateRange.description: The visible date range of the equipment schedule. If a non-valid range is provided, will default a week from today.

defaultZoom.description: Defines the default zoom level on load. Will be restricted to the maximum possible zoom level.

rowHeight.description: Defined the row item height, as well as the grid size.

itemId.description: The item identifier that is this event associates with.

eventId.description: The identifier that used to distinguish this event. Should be unique among other events.

startDate.description: The start date of this event.

endDate.description: The end date of this event.

label.description: The label to be used as the title of the event. Uses the ID if empty.

leadTime.description: The lead time of this event defined in seconds.

leadBackgroundColor.description: The background color of the lead time. Will be overwritten by the lead style.

leadStyle.description: Style applied to the lead time

percentDone.description: The percent completion of the event.

backgroundColor.description: The background color for the scheduled event.

fontColor.description: The font color for the label in the scheduled event.

fontWeight.description: The font weight for the label in the scheduled event.

borderWidth.description: The border width for the scheduled event.

borderColor.description: The border color for the scheduled event.

borderStyle.description: The border color for the scheduled event.

style.description: Style applied to the scheduled event.

itemId.description: The item identifier that is associated with this downtime event.

startDate.description: The start date of the downtime event.

endDate.description: The end date of the downtime event.

underlay.descriptions: Defines whether this downtime even should display above or below other events.

color.description: Defines the color of the downtime event.

opacity.description: Defines the opacity of the downtime event.

style.description: Style applied to the downtime event.

startDate.description: Defines the start date of the break event.

endDate.description: Defines the end date of the break event.

style.description: Style applied to the break event.

breakEvents.description: List of break events. These are scheduled breaks that are applied to all events.

enabled.description: Determines if progress bars should display on scheduled events.
Determines whether or not to show the value along the progress bar.

format.description: Determines the format of the displayed value.

justify.description: Determines the location of the value display.

style.description: Style applied to the value display.

progressBar.description: Style to be applied to all progress bars of scheduled events.

color.description: The color of the time indicator.

opacity.description: The opacity of the time indicator.

width.description: The width of the time indicator.

primaryHeaderStyle.description: Style applied to the primary, top-level header.

secondaryHeaderStyle.description: Style applied to the secondary, grouping header. This will only style the backdrop.

tertiaryHeaderStyle.description: Style applied to the tertiary, unit header. This will only style the backdrop.

rowStyle.description: Base style that is applied to all items.

selectedEventStyle.description: Style that is applied on the selected event. This will override any styling applied to the scheduled event.

scheduledEventStyle.description: Base style that is applied to all scheduled events.

downtimeEventStyle.description: Base style that is applied to all downtime events.

breakEventStyle.description: Base style that is applied to all break events.

bodyStyle.description: Style that is applied to the body of the grid space. This will only affect the back drop.

style.description: Style that is applied to the equipment schedule.

events.name: onAddEvent
events.description: Fired after the event has been added.

itemId.description: The item identifier where this event was created in.

start.description: The start date of the created event.

end.description: The end date of the created event.

events.name: onMoveEvent
events.description: Fired after the event has been moved.

itemId.description: The item identifier where this event was moved.

eventId.description: The event identifier of the event that was moved.

start.description: The new start date of the moved event.

end.description: The new end date of the moved event.

events.name: onResizeEvent
events.description: Fired after the event has been resized

itemId.description: The item identifier where this event was resized.

eventId.description: The event identifier of the event that was resized.

start.description: The new start date of the resized event.

end.description: The new end date of the resized event.

events.name: onDeleteEvent
events.description: Fired after the event has been deleted

itemId.description: The item identifier where this event was deleted.

eventId.description: The event identifier of the event that was deleted.

start.description: The start date of the deleted event.

end.description: The end date of the deleted event.

events.name: onClickEvent
events.description: Fired after the event has been clicked

itemId.description: The item identifier where this event was clicked.

eventId.description: The event identifier of the event that was clicked.

start.description: The start date of the clicked event.

end.description: The end date of the clicked event.
